deleteall.title: Delete all data
deleteall.hint: Remove everything Atap keeps on this PC and start over.
deleteall.confirmTitle: Delete everything Atap keeps on this PC?
deleteall.whatGoes: This deletes your settings, layout, profiles, to-dos, notes, saved passwords and keys, saved data and logs. Atap also stops starting with Windows. This cannot be undone.
deleteall.closes: Atap closes when it is done. Atap itself stays installed, so you can open it again and start fresh.
deleteall.sync: If you sync with OneDrive, the copy there is not deleted.
deleteall.deleting: Deleting your data and closing Atap…
